t: This is 34 Montagu Square, a ground floor and basement flat in a Marylebone terrace. In the mid-1960s it was leased by Ringo Starr of the Beatles. Abbey Road Studios, where the band recorded, is about a mile and a third away. Other residents here have included the Member of Parliament Richard Hanbury Gurney and Lady Emily Charlotte Browne, daughter of the Marquess of Sligo. The square is named after Elizabeth Montagu, a leading figure in London society in the late eighteenth century. The house was designed by the architect Joseph T. Parkinson, who lived from 1782 to 1855.
